_comment: SILICON OUT OF E-WASTE, which is where silicon actually comes from (#276).
AE2 smelts silicon from certus dust, so as shipped CERTUS is the bottleneck for its entire
tree - every processor needs printed silicon and silicon needs certus. Sourcing silicon
separately splits one chokepoint into two, and leaves certus gating only what genuinely needs
a crystal: calculation processors, charged certus, fluix.
SEPARATING, not pulverizing, and the two verbs on this one material do different jobs. E-Scrap
is a mixture - board, die, resin, plastic, plated metal - and taking the silicon die OUT of it
is division. Grinding is what liberates gold from resin, which is why the pulverizing slot
stays Circuit Powder. You do not grind a wafer to get silicon; you take it out.
TEMPORARY, and guarded. This is pack content living in the engine because the pack cannot ship
data on 26.1.2; it leaves with the press pool - Flatts3000/trashlands#46.
The neoforge:mod_loaded guard is load-bearing rather than tidy. Strip it and this file does not
merely fail to apply, it fails to PARSE on its own result id - measured on the Simple Magnets
overrides in #271 - and one bad recipe file leaves a single ERROR line in an otherwise green run.
